$comment: Where the word 'agent' may still appear in src/ after the agent -> sensor rename (RFC-023 §9.5). Read by src/config/__tests__/sensor-vocabulary.test.ts (the guard) and by scripts/rename/sensor-rename.mjs (which leaves these occurrences alone). An occurrence is allowed when the file matches `files` and the occurrence lies inside a match of `pattern` on its line. Do not add an entry to name a sensor concept 'agent': use the sensor vocabulary.

entries.reason: The HTTP User-Agent header, the user_agent session/IOC field and navigator.userAgent are not sensors.
The AI-triage mode 'agent' (self-hosted LLM agent, module ai_triage.agent) is an LLM agent, not a sensor.
Product names of other vendors' agents (Elastic Agent + Fleet, Datadog Agent), cited as prior art.
'Agent' now names one sensor role only: the endpoint agent (RFC-023 §9.1, D18).
Audit rows written before the rename keep action agent.*, resource type agent and metadata agent_* (hash-chained, never rewritten). One constant per spelling; the UI labels both.
Tests that rows written before the rename are labelled.
Migrates browser storage written before the rename (old keys and agents:* values) once, on load.
'Sensors (formerly Agents)' keeps users oriented for two releases after the rename (RFC-023 §9.4).
The guard and its allow-list name the word they guard.
Generated from the relationship-type catalogue; describes third-party EDR agents, not our sensors.

excludedPathsReason: The vendored OpenAPI spec and the types generated from it are copies of the API's spec, which still documents protocol v1 (/api/v1/agent/*, agent_id) on purpose. They change only by re-vendoring (npm run generate:api-types).
